description: Update fields on ONE custom field definition (PATCH — only fields you supply are changed). Editable fields: name, data_type, extra_data. ⚠️ Changing data_type on a field that already has values on documents may render those values invalid or unreadable — change data_type only on unused fields. To set a custom-field VALUE on a document, use update_document or edit_documents_bulk with method 'modify_custom_fields' instead.
name: update_custom_field
